title: Pleadies Tower Spelling
text:
The Pleaides tower is spelled slightly different in Japanese to the word for the constellation, Pleiades, is because the person who named the tower didn't know the correct name at first.

The difference is between the spellings of "Pleiades" in Japanese between "Pleaides Watchtower" (プレアデス監視塔) and "Great Library Pleiades" (大図書館プレイアデス).
